t: The Global Hunger Index 2026 (Concern Worldwide, Welthungerhilfe and Helvetas) ranked India 100th of 122 countries with a score of 24.1, in the 'serious' category.

In the October 2026 Henley Passport Index, Singapore ranked first (visa-free access to 193 destinations) and India rose one place to 84th (55 destinations), sharing the rank with Algeria and Mauritania.

Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan commissioned INS Samarthak, the Indian Navy's indigenous multi-purpose vessel built by Larsen & Toubro at Kattupalli (Tamil Nadu) with over 75% indigenous content, at INS Kadamba, Karwar, Karnataka.
Ladakh created Sankoo, carved out of Kargil district, as the Union Territory's eighth district, approved by Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena.
The Union Cabinet approved a Productivity Linked Bonus of 78 days' wages (Rs 2,009.61 crore) for 11,40,770 railway employees, with a maximum of Rs 17,951 per employee.

Chief Minister V D Satheesan inaugurated the 800-metre Makkekadavu-Nere Kadavu bridge across Vembanad Lake linking Alappuzha and Kottayam districts, and announced a blue economy hub at Aroor under Mission Samudra.
